q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of flexo label printing per square metre?
title: Flexo label printing carbon per m2
short: Divide the press electricity, including UV or hot air drying, by square metres printed, at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Add the label stock, liner, inks and varnish from supplier data, and count make-ready waste, since short runs waste more stock per label.
audience: Label converters, packaging printers and brand owners

ul: Label stock and liner, from supplier data.
Press motors and drying (UV lamps or hot air).

p: Each job needs make-ready material and time. For short runs, waste stock can be a large share, so report per job when runs vary.
Release liner is left with the label user. Note whether a liner recycling scheme is used.

example.title: Worked example: press energy per m2 (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Total: 10,650 / 250,000 = 0.0426 kg CO2 per square metre
Add label stock, inks, varnish and liner from supplier data
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; stock and inks are added from supplier data.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
